entry.note: Confirmed paper is 'Formules de Picard-Lefschetz généralisées et ramification des intégrales' by F. Pham (Bull. SMF 93, 1965, pp.333-367). morse-wall-q-moduli.lean:23 cites it for 'generalised Picard-Lefschetz formula' — paper title is verbatim the citation text. Scope match.

relevance.rationale: INFRA: file absent from HEAD and from the working tree; exists only on origin/claude/upload-bib-papers-2026-05-19 (intake commit 31b8a4d084). Recovered from git history. Identity confirmed from the numdam cover page and the article's own preamble (generalised Picard-Lefschetz formulas, ramification of integrals, Bull. SMF t. 93) and matches the seeded key. Citation status is NOT 'cited' in content/: the ref() entry exists (folio/schema/references.ts:5902) but grep over content/ for `\cite{pham1965}`, `[pham1965]`, `cites: [...pham1965...]`, `Pham` and `Picard-Lefschetz` returns ZERO sites — it is a bib orphan. The 2026-05-19 verification ledger (docs/coordination/2026-05-19-bib-verification-ledger.md:58) records '1 .lean' citation, so a site existed once and has since been removed. The reason is documented and is the honest one: docs/audits/2026-05-18-d2a-categorical-thimble-resolution.md:188 concludes 'standard PL is the *wrong tool*; this is residue calculus', i.e. the corpus deliberately abandoned the Picard-Lefschetz thimble route the reference was added (line 286 of that audit) to support. So this is a reference retained for a superseded route. Scope-(a): as read, this document supplies nothing the current corpus consumes; that is not a claim that generalised Picard-Lefschetz is excluded from any future thimble treatment.

proposedActions.rationale: The route this reference was added for was retired by the corpus's own audit; re-citing it would reinstate an abandoned scaffold. Leave the ref() entry as historical background. Flag only if prop:morse-wall-q-moduli (the audit's replacement skeleton) is ever built on a PL argument.
